findings.Quote: Someone handed me a door that opened the right direction, and I didn't check whose hand was on the latch.

findings.Fix: Vary the image or cut repetition — have her use a different, more literal description of the deception.

findings.Quote: a wound small enough to carry without letting it change how she counted for everyone else
findings.Note: Abstract, self-consciously literary phrasing that tells rather than shows the emotional math it's describing; the metaphor doesn't quite parse literally (a wound that changes 'how she counted').
findings.Fix: Cut to something concrete: 'Seven dead. She'd never let the number show on her face again.'

findings.Quote: The three fingers started up again. She let them.
findings.Note: With no prior beat context here, the action and its stakes read as vague/ambiguous shorthand rather than a legible moment.
findings.Fix: add a concrete anchor (what the fingers are doing/why letting them matters) if this is meant to land independently

findings.Quote: That breath was everything.
findings.Note: Vague melodramatic capper that tells rather than shows the significance already conveyed by the preceding concrete detail.
findings.Fix: Cut the line; let the palm-on-pillar image close the beat.

findings.Quote: because the rest had weight
findings.Fix: Cut the abstraction; show what the pause cost her or what she braced for instead of naming 'weight.'

findings.Quote: She'd been the bad, once. She was the call he'd meant.
findings.Note: Pseudo-profound aphoristic construction that tells the emotional history rather than showing it; relies on wordplay ('the bad'/'the call') instead of concrete detail.
findings.Fix: Replace with a specific memory or line of dialogue that implies the history without the symmetrical wordplay.

findings.Quote: because you're the only one I trust to carry more than they were rated for
findings.Note: Reads as a constructed aphorism/metaphor asserted for thematic weight rather than earned in-scene; the load-rating image is doing symbolic work but is stated flatly as truth rather than dramatized.
findings.Fix: Ground the metaphor in a concrete referent from their shared history or cut the abstraction and let the ask stand plainly.

findings.Note: Metaphor collapses under literal scrutiny — a 'door' made of a contract 'word' with 'hands full' tries to visualize an abstraction and produces a muddled image rather than clarity.
findings.Fix: Cut the door metaphor here entirely; let it land once, later, rather than pre-empting it three times in four beats.

findings.Quote: a door that locked behind twelve people to teach her how not to
findings.Note: Fourth door image across four consecutive beats — what might work once as a motif has become a verbal tic, undercutting the weight of this specific moment.
findings.Fix: Replace with a distinct, non-door image specific to Sefi's situation.

findings.Quote: The question held the room a second.
findings.Note: Vague personification-of-silence filler that tells rather than shows what actually happened in the room.
findings.Fix: Cut or replace with a concrete beat: e.g. 'Nobody answered right away.'

findings.Quote: Rook knew what it was. She did the same thing herself.

findings.Quote: There were twenty-one on that barge, and the manifest I cleared listed forty names across the quarter. Forty I audited. I never read a forty-first.
findings.Note: the numbers don't logically connect to the chapter's setup of a 'forty-first' name being the missing one — if he audited forty and never read a forty-first, it's unclear how a name went missing at all; the arithmetic of the confession is muddled
findings.Fix: clarify: e.g. 'the manifest listed forty names across the quarter — but there were forty-one riders. I never read the forty-first.'

findings.Note: Purple/abstract phrasing that gestures at profundity without literal sense — 'choice... where it would hold' doesn't clarify what she's choosing or why cold preserves it.
findings.Fix: State the choice concretely, then let the coldness be shown through action, not asserted as a container for it.

findings.Fix: Cut the abstraction; let the physical gesture (the pause, the withdrawal) carry the meaning without the explanatory tag.
